svg.aria-label: Four merged pull requests arrive one by one: feat raises the version from v1.3.0 to v1.4.0, fix to v1.4.1, docs releases nothing, and feat! raises it to v2.0.0. The changelog gains a line for each release and Release v2.0.0 is published.
svg.text: Merge a PR. The version follows.
The title type decides the bump; nobody types a version.
